fields.description: Which version the learner was signed off against. A material change afterwards is exactly the case where the sign-off has to be done again.
fields.label: Course Version

fields.description: The attempt this follows, when there was one. A practical sign-off can stand alone — some things are only ever proved by watching somebody do them.
fields.label: Attempt

fields.description: The learner. Named `user` to match Training Assignment / Attempt / Completion — training/permissions.py scopes every learner-owned row on a column of this exact name, so anything else silently loses row-level scoping.
fields.label: Learner

fields.description: Who is attesting. Named as an Employee rather than a User because this is a statement made in a role — the person's login may change or go away, the attestation does not.
fields.label: Supervisor

fields.description: Derived from the supervisor's Employee record, not typed — this is what the submit-time check compares against the session user.
fields.label: Supervisor User

fields.description: When the learner raised the request. NOT the attestation -- see `attested_on`. Relabelled in v1.396.0; the stored values are unchanged.
fields.label: Requested On

fields.description: Three outcomes, and the middle one exists because forcing a choice between the other two makes supervisors overstate. Competent means “I would send them alone”. Supervised Only means “they did the whole job, with me there” — real, recorded progress that does NOT complete the course or satisfy a rung requirement, because the system must stop reporting them as ready to go out alone. Needs More Practice is how a supervisor says “come back to me” without the learner losing their attempt.
fields.label: Outcome
fields.options:
Competent
Supervised Only
Needs More Practice

fields.description: What was actually observed, against the course's What To Verify. Required when the outcome is Needs More Practice — an unexplained "not yet" gives the learner nothing to work on.
fields.label: Competency Notes

fields.description: Optional. A drawn or photographed signature, for the customers who ask for one on a handover pack.
fields.label: Signature

fields.description: Why this person was allowed to attest, decided at submit by training/authority.py. Snapshotted rather than recomputed: a link resolves to today, and what an audit asks in 2029 is what was true when the attestation was made.
fields.label: Authority Basis
fields.options:
Observed Supervisor
Position Tier
Manager Delegate

fields.description: The attesting person's position at the moment they signed.
fields.label: Supervisor Position

fields.description: The learner's position at the moment they were signed off.
fields.label: Learner Position

fields.description: When the supervisor actually attested, stamped at submit. `signed_on` is when the learner RAISED the request, which on rows predating v1.396.0 is the only date there is -- so an as-of-date query must read this field and treat its absence as 'not reconstructible', never fall back to signed_on.
fields.label: Attested On

fields.description: The TITLE, frozen. `supervisor_position` beside it is a Link and resolves to today, so renaming a rung silently restates every historical attestation.
fields.label: Supervisor Position At Time
